_comment: Daily bounty fights (master plan item 1117) and the 100 percent certificate (item 1120). Read by scripts/core/Bounties.gd. Every day the Fixer pins three crooks on the board, the same for everyone. Beat one for its price; the Fixer skims a cut, and sometimes a snitch tips the mark off (tip_chance): the mark comes two rings stronger and the price doubles. Trust no one.

marks.name: Velvet Tam
marks.crime: Sold the same alley to three gangs. Twice.

marks.name: Half-Ear Osk
marks.crime: Borrowed the Fixer's cart. Returned the wheels.

marks.name: Mother Greel
marks.crime: Runs a soup kitchen. The soup is evidence.

marks.name: The Accountant
marks.crime: Knows where the money went. All of it.

marks.name: Lucky Brannoch
marks.crime: Nobody is that lucky. Check his sleeves.

marks.name: Quiet Wenna
marks.crime: Said nothing to the wardens. That is the problem.

certificate_lines: This paper says you did everything. Frame it. Somebody will try to forge it by Thursday.
Signed by the Fixer, witnessed by a man who swears he was never here.
